The '''Kallea sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Atlas" />

It was supposedly named for [[Freia Kallea/Legends|Freia Kallea]] who charted the remaining portion of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] to [[Imynusoph/Legends|Imynusoph]].<ref name="TEA" />
